mood: Loud, humid and electric: 1997 Hong Kong rooftops lit by pink and yellow neon signs and a cyan hanzi sign.

shape.borderStyle: 2px solid neon pink with an outer glow (box-shadow, no blur animation)

buttonStyle: Primary is a dark button with a thick pink neon outline and pink Bungee text that brightens to white on hover; secondary uses a yellow neon outline.
backdrop: Dark tenement skyline with a handful of neon sign boxes that glow at a steady level (static glow), plus slow CSS rain streaks and a soft pink haze at street level.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
